assertions: source sha256, data row count, and column count equal source
tenant slot fields are present exactly as tenant_fields
benchmark refuses when run against a different sample
CMBS-SRC-001.failure_meaning: source compatibility regressed or the benchmark is using the wrong public sample

assertions: 6000 rows expand to 18000 tenant slots
10143 non-empty tenant observations preserve rank, square feet, lease expiration, filing, property, and asset provenance
7857 blank tenant slots are skipped with deterministic counts
CMBS-EXTRACT-001.failure_meaning: tenant extraction lost observations, preserved blanks as tenants, or dropped replay context

assertions: surface 0 has placeholder expectation unresolved_placeholder_not_entity
placeholder exact buckets never become tenant entities
placeholder counts remain diagnostics rather than promotion evidence
full sample and shuffled sample produce identical prepared surface ids
summary counters are deterministic across row order
raw row ids remain provenance and do not participate in candidate identity
CMBS-PREP-001.failure_meaning: prepare became row-order-sensitive or row-level instead of surface-level

assertions: must-link clusters include Sears, 24 Hour Fitness, Foot Locker, TJ Maxx, and numeric brand variants
variants inside a cluster are candidates or compact exact-bucket members
normalization records legal suffix, punctuation, all-caps, store-number, and leading-record-number evidence
CMBS-NK-001.failure_meaning: namekit or blocking dropped tenant-label recall for known public-sample clusters

assertions: every raw variant pair inside each must-link cluster reaches candidate evidence or a compact exact-bucket assertion
candidate evidence names the recovering operator
common-token caps do not suppress required must-link recall
CMBS-CAND-001.failure_meaning: blocking is too brittle for the solver to recover known tenant-label clusters

assertions: numeric and address-like hard negatives never auto-merge
same-property context is not sufficient support for tenant identity
hard negatives land in cannot-link, no-edge, review, or escrow outcomes
CMBS-HARDNEG-001.failure_meaning: anti-merge protection regressed for numeric, address, or same-property false positives

assertions: d/b/a, slash, tenant-shell, parenthetical, and typo cases are grouped once by ambiguity pattern
review groups include row count, deal/property count, representative rows, support, anti-merge or relation evidence, and suggested action
review import can produce alias, distinct, or relation patches without silent auto-collapse
CMBS-REVIEW-001.failure_meaning: review grouping became noisy, unsafe, or insufficient for operator decisions

assertions: high-repeat exact buckets emit compact assertions instead of pairwise rows
placeholder 0 exact bucket is excluded from entity buckets
record count grows O(N), not O(N^2)
must-link support can form promotable clusters
hard cannot-link splits, abstains, or emits contradiction
relation hints do not add positive merge score by default
CMBS-SOLVE-001.failure_meaning: solver constraints regressed to threshold-only fuzzy matching

assertions: accepted review decisions promote exact aliases into a normal registry
entity apply appends canonical fields without mutating raw fields
ordinary core canon lookup resolves promoted aliases exactly
CMBS-REPLAY-001.failure_meaning: promotion or exact replay stopped producing durable registry knowledge

assertions: candidate generation operates on 431 unique raw names, not 10143 raw observations
exact-bucket pair expansion is 0
telemetry records row count, unique surface count, candidate count, edge count, exact bucket count, suppressed candidates, review groups, artifact sizes, cache status, and timing metadata
CMBS-PERF-001.failure_meaning: full-sample performance regressed structurally before wall-clock gating

assertions: full sample and deterministic shuffle produce identical prepared surfaces
candidate, edge, solve, and review artifacts match after canonical sorting
apply output matches after sorting by source_row_id
CMBS-PERF-002.failure_meaning: hidden row-order dependence entered the benchmark pipeline

non_goals: do not commit the full public CSV by default
do not introduce frontier model calls
do not introduce Python or general ML framework runtime dependencies
do not silently collapse legal obligor, brand hierarchy, ownership, or investor identity into tenant-label identity
